fix: Read 'arrondi ou subéchancré' as a union of rounded and emarginate (PATO:0002234). The 'sub-' prefix gives value_qualifier approximately (pattern 01). Add the French rule 'échancré' → emarginate. The bearer should be the middle lobe of the lip (the 'lobe médian'), not the whole epichile.
reason: The disjunction is two shape values of one attribute, which is the union pattern. What blocks it is the French word 'subéchancré' with no rule, plus a bearer that is too broad.

fix: 'dichasial' is not a stage. Add it to config/flora_context_words.tsv as a bearer word, or use pattern 12 (bract part of a dichasium), so the stage kind is not triggered. Ground 'apex' to the apex region (slot 1). Read 'obtuse, acuminate to cuspidate' as alternatives of the apex shape: obtuse PATO:0001935 or the continuum acuminate–cuspidate.
reason: This is a plain apex-shape statement about a named kind of bract. The stage reason is a false trigger.

fix: Bearer fruit, value dehiscent FLOPO:0991149 in OWL. 'tardily' is stored only in RDF as a timing qualifier with its cue, like frequency_qualifier, so the class stays plain dehiscent. 'Late' gives no new class.
reason: The term exists. 'tardily' changes when the fruit opens, not what it is, and no pattern carries that.

fix: 'adaxially' is already a surface row. Allow the cue when it stands directly before the value inside the statement span, even though 'abaxially' appears earlier in the same comma-joined clause. Allow a degree word ('moderately') between cue and value. Bearer leaf lamina adaxial epidermis, value pilose FLOPO:0991048.
reason: Slot 1 (surface) covers this. The rule 'context word once per clause' and the degree word block it.

fix: Counted part inflorescence, container whole plant. Quality amount with a qualitative value class ('numerous': many, more than a usual number, not given as a figure) in place of a data range. 'souvent' goes to frequency_qualifier and 'très' to a degree cue, both RDF only.
reason: Pattern 03 holds non-numeric counts (measurement_value_not_numeric). 'numerous' needs its own value. This item is weak: inflorescences per plant, 'often very'.

fix: The count is of rows of sori (an aggregate, as in 'jugate'), 1 per side. Bearer: sorus row, part of a lateral region of the pinnule on each side of the midrib (slot 1 part_restrictions, BSPO side). Amount 1 with a per_side flag in RDF. OWL: has part some (sorus and part of some (lateral region and part of some pinnule)).
reason: Count at a position is listed as open in annotation-context-patterns.md. 'amount' of sori is also the wrong thing counted: 1 counts rows, not sori.

fix: Annotate 'long petioles' as petiole increased length PATO:0000573. Record 'may exceed 30 cm' only as a rare upper extreme (value_max_extreme > 30 cm, RDF only, pattern 05). It is not a lower bound of all petioles.
reason: 'may exceed' is a cue the parser lacks. Read as 'more than', it would wrongly claim every petiole is over 30 cm.

target: count of parts with a quality
fix: Counted part: stamen that has fertile PATO:0000955. Container: the shorter stamens of the flower (series member). Amount 1–2, frequency 'occasionally' in RDF. 'Shorter stamens sterile' is annotated separately as sterile PATO:0000956.
reason: The statement says how many members of a set have a quality, not that the set has it. Neither pattern 03 nor pattern 08 says this.

fix: 'at base' is a region row. Allow it after the value and ground it to stem base PO:0008039 with value procumbent PATO:0002389. 'distally ascending to erect' is a separate statement on the distal region.
reason: Slot 1 (region) covers this. It was misread as a stage.

fix: Read the 'to 10 cm' in brackets after 'long' as an inclusive upper bound on branch length, with 'usually' as frequency_qualifier. Bearer: the branch of the head array, i.e. the inflorescence branch.
reason: 'to' is a supported cue. The brackets and the preceding qualitative value block it.

fix: Bearer calyx lobe (not sepal), towards calyx tube, ratio 2 with 'nearly' as approximate cue (pattern 01). Allow 'nearly' before 'twice'.
reason: Pattern 10 covers 'twice as long as'. It is blocked by the 'nearly' cue and the second part of a gamosepalous calyx.

fix: Union of flat PATO:0000407 or sunken PATO:0002416 ('impressed' → sunken for veins, add the rule if missing). 'somewhat' is a degree cue on the second value. 'above' is the adaxial side (slot 1).
reason: Two values of one surface attribute. A rule for 'impressed' and a degree cue are what is missing.

fix: The quality 'pericarp' is a structure. The text says the seeds leave the pericarp after ripening, i.e. the fruit opens or breaks down at maturity. If it is kept, annotate fruit dehiscent FLOPO:0991149 with stage mature. Otherwise leave it.
reason: The transcribed quality is a part, not a quality.

fix: Add the comparison cue 'paler than' (a lighter-colour PATO quality, e.g. decreased intensity PATO:0001783, to confirm) with towards. Ground 'surface' to the organ of the sentence (leaf lamina), not to a term of its own.
reason: This is a comparison with a second part. Only the cue and the grounding of 'surface' are missing.

fix: Strip the FNA markup '˂…˃' before parsing. '˂' is an opening bracket, not '<'. Then 'to 80 cm' is an inclusive upper bound of whole plant PO:0000003 height.
reason: A markup character was taken for a strict-bound sign.

fix: Add the cue 'to more than': the largest plants exceed 5 m. Store it in RDF as value_max_extreme > 5 m, with no OWL data range. For a climber the attribute is stem length, not height.
reason: 'to more than' is not a bound on all plants. It is a lower bound on the maximum.

fix: Bearer: the perianth of the flower bud. Value cleft/split PATO:0001786. The depth of the incision is a ratio to the bearer's length (3/4–4/5, unit ratio) in RDF, as in pattern 11. An absolute depth gets a length unit (see P01632).
reason: How deep an organ is divided is a measure of the incision, not of the bearer. No pattern carries it.

fix: Bearer style (and the staminal tube, as a second record). Value exserted PATO:0000623 towards corolla (pattern 09, OWL). The projection is a distance PATO:0000040 with data range 0.2–0.9 cm on the same record, also in RDF.
reason: Pattern 09 says comparisons with a measurement are not read.

fix: Bearer stigma, value exserted PATO:0000623 towards anther, distance 2–5 mm as in P01617.
reason: The same construction: a relation to another part with a measured distance.

fix: Read a sex adjective before a part ('female glumes') as pattern 12: glume PO:0009039 part of a spikelet or flower that has female. Value scarious FLOPO:0991047.
reason: Pattern 12 reads 'of female flowers'. The adjective form is not read and is wrongly sent to the stage kind.

fix: Counted part stamen, container flower. Quality amount with the qualitative value 'numerous' (indefinite, many). OWL uses the value class in place of a data range.
reason: 'Stamens numerous' is a real diagnostic character, but pattern 03 accepts only numbers.

target: ultimate segment: the smallest, last-order free division of a divided frond or leaf (pinnule or lobe of a pinnule)
fix: With the term, pattern 09 applies: decreased length PATO:0000574 towards the ultimate segment, frequency 'usually'. Ground the fern 'costa' to the pinna midvein, not PO:0030072, which is the bryophyte costa.
reason: The comparison is supported. Its second term has no class.

target: lip appendage: an outgrowth of the orchid labellum (as in Disperis)
fix: With the container grounded (part of the lip), '2 lobes' is a count by pattern 03, or the rule bilobed.
reason: The count is fine. Its container 'appendage' does not ground.

fix: Add a grounding rule for numbered 'scales' of a grass spikelet: first scale = lower glume, second = upper glume, third = sterile lower lemma. Then 3-nerved → vein amount 3, with each scale as container.
reason: 'N-nerved' is supported. Only the older numbered 'scale' wording lacks grounding.

fix: Counted part secondary vein, container leaf lamina, restricted to one side of the midvein (slot 1, BSPO lateral side). Amount 8–10 per side. OWL: has part some (secondary vein and part of some (lateral region and part of some leaf lamina)) with the data range. RDF per_side true.
reason: Listed as open in annotation-context-patterns.md (count_per_position).

fix: Add a rule that resolves 'X or narrowly/broadly so' to 'X or narrowly/broadly X'. Here: union of ovate PATO:0001891 and narrowly ovate.
reason: This is a plain union of shape values. 'so' refers back to the earlier value and is not resolved.

fix: Read 'to (a-)b' as an inclusive upper bound b (1.5 cm). Keep the '(1-)' in brackets as a variant of the bound in RDF text only.
reason: 'to' is supported. The extreme in brackets inside the bound blocks it.

fix: Accept '+' after an extreme ('200+') as an open extreme (value_max_extreme ≥ 200, RDF). Split 'L × W' into length and width ranges, each with its extremes.
reason: The range with extremes is supported. The '+' sign stops it.

fix: The subject is the callus of the lip, not the lip. If it is kept, annotate presence of a keel on the median region of the lip (slot 1), joined to the callus. 'V-shaped' is a separate statement about the callus.
reason: The transcribed entity and the free-text quality do not match the structure of the text.

fix: Bearer stamen, value inserted into PATO:0000624 towards corolla (pattern 09). The landmark is the base of the corolla, with distance PATO:0000040 1.5–2.5 mm. 'which is 0.3 of tube length' is a ratio in RDF only.
reason: Pattern 09 keeps the insertion region only as text and does not read a measured distance.

fix: Add 'drying' as a specimen_condition cue (dried). Then 'drying shiny or membranous' goes to the dried condition, and 'blade coriaceous' is annotated on its own with the existing coriaceous value.
reason: The disjunction belongs to the dried specimen, not to the living blade.

fix: Split off the count: lobe amount 6–8, with the staminal tube margin as container. Annotate 'truncate or irregularly lobed' separately as an alternative on the lobe shape (pattern 07).
reason: The disjunction is about the shape of the counted lobes and should not block the count.

fix: Bearer petal, value split PATO:0001786. The depth of the split is a length (1–1.5 mm) of the incision, stored on the record and in RDF.
reason: The same construction as P01616, with an absolute depth.

fix: As P01624: secondary vein, amount 2 per side of the midvein, container leaf lamina.
reason: Count at a position is open.

fix: Counted part flower, container the inflorescence (the dichotomous cymes). Value 'numerous'.
reason: A non-numeric count. Pattern 03 holds it.

fix: Counted part leaf with basal position FLOPO:0991002 (pattern 04), container whole plant. Value 'numerous'.
reason: A non-numeric count of a member of a series.
'Unknown' says the specimens lack these organs. It is not absence in the plant, so it is no phenotype.

fix: Counted part cauline leaf (FLOPO:0991117 position), container stem. Value 'several' (a few, about 3–7). Only if 'several' is accepted as a value; otherwise leave it.
reason: A non-numeric count, and a vaguer one than 'numerous'.

fix: Add the rule 'persisting/persistent' → non-deciduous PATO:0001732 on the calyx lobe. Read 'to enclose mature capsule' as an enclosing relation towards fruit (add the cue), with stage mature.
reason: The process word is a quality under another name, as annotation-context-patterns.md §5 says. The relation needs one cue.

fix: 'parted' → lobe is already in config/flora_counted_parts.tsv. Split '5-parted' into calyx lobe amount 5 and do not let the trailing 'to base' block the split. Keep 'to base' as a depth-of-division cue in RDF.
reason: This is a count inside a word, which the table covers. The reason given was wrong.
